verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen streaming and remote control app. Remote-access tools could plausibly offer user-defined background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent behaviors: Launch at Login, a daily update check, and automatic network handoff. None of these lets a user set up autonomous automations or scheduled tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
